description: This file declares utility functions related to session server states and logging levels within the Rialto server manager's common utilities. It includes function prototypes for converting session states to strings, converting logging levels, and setting local log levels.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a SessionServerState enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a LoggingLevel enum to a RIALTO_DEBUG_LEVEL.

methods.name: setLocalLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the local log levels based on the provided LoggingLevels object.
